subject: general
question: Which of the following books is NOT written by Ruskin Bond?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Midnight’s Children**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ruskin Bond is an Indian author of British descent.**
 
• He received the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1992 for his novel Our Trees Still Grow in Dehra.
 
• **The Blue Umbrella, The Room on the Roof, Roads to Mussoorie and Cherry Tree are some of his famous works.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Midnight's Children is a 1981 novel by Indian-British writer Salman Rushdie, about India's transition from **British colonial rule to independence and partition.**
 
• Salman Rushdie's Midnight's Children is a harsh critique of the gender-related power struggles of postcolonial Indian society.
 
• Sir Ahmed Salman Rushdie is an Indian-born British-American novelist.
 
• His notable works include; Shame, The Satanic Verses, Haroun and the Sea of Stories, The Moor's Last Sigh, The Ground Beneath Her Feet, Fury, Shalimar the Clown etc.
